projects.name: Vewrite
projects.description:
Hey there! What is this? Simply put, Vewrite is a project management tool for technical writers, teams, and developer relations units. The core concept behind Vewrite is that teams who are managing projects with deliverables should be able to create a workflow that supports them, so that they can quickly create their deliverables. Automated workflows should allow teams to avoid manually pushing deliverable through the process.

At the end of the day, the goal is to allow writers to be more independent, while increasing visibility for leaders and stakeholders.

https://github.com/ramijames/vewrite/

featured.description: As more and more people are using miserablyunemployed.com, I'm getting more and more awesome feedback like this. I can't think of anything better than waking up to a support message that is so positive and confirming. It's the number one reason that I build stuff. I just want to make people's lives better.

Mondays are the day that most people sign up for Miserably Unemployed. I guess that makes sense, but it always surprises me. Weekends are downtime, even for people who are looking for work.

Me? Well, I just keep going day and night. I almost never take a day off and I'm always either building something new, maintaining something old, or running support for one or the other.

It just keeps going.

Miserably Unemployed is the first thing that I've built in a long while that seems to have some legs. It gets daily improvements and you can start to really feel the vision behind the product.

At the end of the day, I want to build a place that makes getting a job feel less like a job. Your life is already stressful enough, right? I want to make at least that one part of it easier.

I hope that today is the day that you join us. Thousands of others already have. 

Link is in the first comment.

Much love, Rami.
